page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7ne.xlarge is a general-purpose instance configured with 4 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at 3.3 GHz, the instance features 4 physical cores with 1.0 thread per core on a KVM hypervisor. The CPU architecture is x86_64, incorporating a 33 MB L3 cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 KB L1d cache. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate moderate single-core capabilities alongside weaker multi-core and memory throughput. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance is average at 1571.79, and single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression also score in the average tier. However, multi-core execution is limited, with stress-ng multi-core CPU performance and PassMark CPU scores falling into the bottom 25% weak category. Memory bandwidth tests, including large-block read and write operations, also register in the weak tier, though the PassMark memory score maintains an average rating.

The instance exhibits a clear tradeoff between single-threaded efficiency and multi-threaded scaling. While single-core tasks perform adequately, multi-threaded workloads like bzip3 decompression show poor performance. Database operations and Redis SET operations also rank in the bottom 25%, suggesting limitations for high-throughput transactional databases. This instance is suited for general-purpose workloads, basic web serving, and lightweight single-threaded applications that do not require high-speed local storage or intensive multi-core parallel processing.
